headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:

▸ NVIDIA /auto-ontology：Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. I

▸ mattpocock /skills：Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.

▸ thedotmack /claude-mem：Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sess
